statement.notes: Mapping notes: 1) 'Cash and due from banks' mapped to cash. 2) 'Accrued interest and accounts receivable' mapped to accounts_receivable. 3) 'Investment securities, net of allowance for credit losses' mapped to investment_in_securities (this includes available-for-sale, held-to-maturity, and other investment securities). 4) 'Accounts payable and other liabilities' mapped to accounts_payable_and_or_other_liabilities. 5) 'Short-term borrowings' mapped to short_term_debt. 6) 'Long-term debt' mapped to long_term_debt. 7) 'Total stockholders’ equity' mapped to total_equity. 8) total_non_current_liabilities and total_current_liabilities not directly stated in the statement (no breakdown provided). 9) advance_payments_for_purchases and advance_payments_from_sales not present for this financial institution. 10) inventory not applicable for a bank.
